sources.quote: Theta Lyrae, also named Ninnisig, is a red giant star in the constellation Lyra, approximately 760 light-years away from Earth.

introduction.text: Its brightness, measured band by band, gives 1,579 times the Sun's luminosity at 4,507 K, so 65.259 solar radii.
